content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Newman CLI: Execution and Reporters"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Newman is a command-line collection runner for Postman. It enables you to effortlessly run and test a Postman collection directly from the command line, making it an essential tool for integrating API tests into your CI/CD pipelines."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Installation"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Before running Newman, you need to have Node.js installed on your machine. You can then install Newman globally using the Node Package Manager (npm)."},{"order":5,"type":"code","text":"npm install -g newman"},{"order":6,"type":"subheading","text":"Basic Collection Execution"},{"order":7,"type":"paragraph","text":"To execute a collection, point Newman to your exported Postman collection JSON file. You can also pass a corresponding environment file to supply variables."},{"order":8,"type":"code","text":"newman run collection.json -e environment.json"},{"order":9,"type":"subheading","text":"Understanding Reporters"},{"order":10,"type":"paragraph","text":"Reporters provide feedback on the test run. Newman comes with built-in support for CLI, JSON, HTML, and JUnit reporters. You can specify multiple reporters using the --reporters flag."},{"order":11,"type":"code","text":"newman run collection.json -r cli,json,html"},{"order":12,"type":"subheading","text":"Advanced HTML Reporting"},{"order":13,"type":"paragraph","text":"To generate rich HTML reports, you can install thehtmlextra reporter, which provides a detailed, graphical view of your test execution results."},{"order":14,"type":"code","text":"npm install -g newman-reporter-htmlextra"},{"order":15,"type":"paragraph","text":"Once installed, run your collection with the htmlextra reporter flag to generate a customizable report file."},{"order":16,"type":"code","text":"newman run collection.json -r htmlextra"},{"order":17,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use -r cli to view real-time logs in your terminal."},{"order":18,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use -r junit to output XML reports compatible with Jenkins and other CI tools."},{"order":19,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use --reporter-htmlextra-export to define a custom path for your generated HTML report."}]
